class.name: Room
class.brief_description: A subtree with a working directory.
class.description: A [Room] gives a part of the world a place on disk. Slates held inside it run their Claude session in [member room_dir]; agent bodies standing in it report it as their location. At runtime the room creates its directory if needed, writes a small [code].opendust-room.json[/code] marker there, and registers itself with the OpenDust agent bridge so [code]world.rooms[/code] can list it. The directory is the room's memory. There is deliberately nothing else.

method.name: find_room_for
method.description: Returns the nearest [Room] that is [param node] or one of its ancestors, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_absolute_dir
method.description: [member room_dir] resolved to an absolute filesystem path.

members.member: Human-friendly name shown on slates. Falls back to [member room_id].
Absolute path, [code]res://[/code], [code]user://[/code], or a path relative to the project. Empty means the project directory.
Stable, human-legible id. Defaults to the node name in snake_case at runtime if left empty.
